posts.context: Older relatives give outdated financial advice while urban living costs soar.
posts.angle: Family wisdom assumes living costs in tech hubs still operate on 1998 economics.
slides: "Aaj kal ke bachhe Bangalore mein savings kyun nahi karte?"

"Salary is fifty thousand."
"PG rent is thirty thousand."
"Auto driver asked ₹200 for one kilometre."
"Swiggy charge is forty rupees."
posts.caption: Every family WhatsApp group has an uncle offering this solution. 🏠
posts.rank_verdict: Violates the single-price rule by turning the middle slide into a ledger of amounts.
